# Vietnam Accounting 30-Day Interactive Learning Web

> Interactive Vietnamese Accounting learning and simulation platform covering Circular 99/2025/TT-BTC (effective 01/01/2026), Circular 58/2026/TT-BTC (micro-enterprise regime, effective 01/07/2026, replacing Circular 132/2018), Circular 200/2014/TT-BTC, Circular 133/2016/TT-BTC (SME), Law on Accounting 88/2015/QH13, VAT Law 48/2024/QH15 (5M VND non-cash threshold from 01/07/2025), E-Invoicing Decree 254/2026/ND-CP (effective 01/07/2026, replacing Decrees 123/2020 & 70/2025) with Circular 91/2026/TT-BTC (effective 01/07/2026, replacing Circular 32/2025 & 78/2021: invoice code digits 1-9, computer-generated invoices, 4-step correction), PIT Law 109/2025/QH15, Resolution 110/2025/UBTVQH15 (new family deductions 15.5M/6.2M VND/month applied to the WHOLE tax year 2026 from 01/01/2026), Circular 87/2026/TT-BTC (PIT procedures, effective 01/07/2026, replacing Circular 111/2013), SME 30% CIT/PIT reduction Decree 398/2026/ND-CP (tax years 2026-2027, revenue <= 10B VND; detailed by Resolution 43/2026/QH16), Tax payment extension Decree 245/2026/ND-CP (effective 2026-06-27 to 2026-12-30), Household business threshold Decree 141/2026/ND-CP amending Decree 68/2026/ND-CP (500M -> 1B VND/year from tax year 2026), Household business filings Circular 18/2026/TT-BTC (effective 2026-03-05, amended by Circular 50/2026/TT-BTC), VAT 2% reduction Decree 174/2025/ND-CP (8% rate only until 31/12/2026, back to 10% from 01/01/2027), E-Commerce Tax Decree 117/2025/ND-CP & Decree 68/2026/ND-CP, Global Minimum Tax Decree 236/2025/ND-CP (TK 82112 top-up CIT), and Foreign Contractor Tax (Circular 89/2026/TT-BTC, effective 01/07/2026, replacing Circular 103/2014/TT-BTC with unchanged revenue-based rates; filings 01/NTNN & 02/NTNN).

## Core Learning & Simulation Modules

- [Chart of Accounts Explorer](https://hoa.tanhdev.com/#coa): Interactive lookup across Circular 99/2025/TT-BTC, Circular 58/2026/TT-BTC (micro-enterprise, conversion dataset from TT 132/2018), Circular 200/2014/TT-BTC (154 accounts), and Circular 133/2016/TT-BTC (57 SME accounts + 13 prohibited accounts safeguard)
- [30-Day Curriculum](https://hoa.tanhdev.com/#curriculum): 10 structured modules, 30 daily lessons, 100 concepts, and 100 Webb's DOK 1-3 milestone test items with Rule of One diagnostic feedback. New 2026 tax-update concepts live in Day 30 of Module 10 (ND 398/2026 30% reduction + 2027 rollover traps: VAT 8% expiry, ND 245/2026 extension ending, TT 101/2026 chief accountant certificate) — add new concepts there before spawning new days
- [Double-Entry Journalizer Workbench](https://hoa.tanhdev.com/#workbench): Real-time Debit/Credit balance validation, T-account ledger posting, and 3-tier Socratic anti-spoil hint ladder
- [Dynamic Financial Statements (B01-DN, B02-DN, B03-DN)](https://hoa.tanhdev.com/#financial-statements): Automated Statement of Financial Position (B01-DN), Income Statement (B02-DN), and Indirect Cash Flow Statement (B03-DN)
- [COGS & Manufacturing Cost Workbench](https://hoa.tanhdev.com/#cogs): FIFO vs Weighted Average inventory valuation, TK 154 WIP Z/z unit cost calculator, and VAS 02 Paragraph 11 abnormal waste separation
- [Tax & E-Invoice Guardrails Inspector](https://hoa.tanhdev.com/#voucher): Non-cash payment checks (20M legacy & 5M VAT Law 48/2024/QH15), vendor tax status (00/03/04), CIT Schedule B4 adjustments, PIT deduction guardrail (NQ 110/2025: 15.5M/6.2M from tax year 2026), SME 30% CIT/PIT reduction guardrail (ND 398/2026), VAT 2% reduction window guardrail (8% until 31/12/2026), FCT Circular 89/2026 calculator, plus two dedicated engines: E-Commerce Tax (ND 117/2025 + ND 68/2026: platform withholding, 1B VND household threshold per ND 141/2026) and R&D Deduction (Law 67/2025 + ND 320/2025: 150-200% super deduction)

## Agent Interfaces

- [Auth.md](https://hoa.tanhdev.com/auth.md): Agentic registration and OAuth 2.1 + PKCE discovery contract
- [Agent Card](https://hoa.tanhdev.com/.well-known/agent-card.json): A2A 1.0 agent discovery manifest
- [Agent Registry](https://hoa.tanhdev.com/.well-known/agent-registry.json): A2A 1.0 machine registry
- [API Catalog](https://hoa.tanhdev.com/.well-known/api-catalog): RFC 9727 API catalog linkset
- [MCP Server Card](https://hoa.tanhdev.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): MCP 2026-07-28 stateless streamable-http server card
- [Agent Skills Index](https://hoa.tanhdev.com/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json): agentskills.io v1.0 capability manifest
- [AI Catalog](https://hoa.tanhdev.com/.well-known/ai-catalog.json): Linux Foundation Tier-3 AI Catalog
